title: VAFM problems
author: Bjenkins1
issue_summary: 1986.5-1992 Toyota Supra experiencing erratic idle surging between 700-900rpm when warmed up, with the condition improving when the VAFM (Vane Air Flow Meter) is disconnected.
symptoms: Idle fluctuates between 700-900rpm when warmed up
Idle surges or hunts, especially after throttle input
Engine sometimes drops RPM like it will die then recovers
fix_summary: Air leak found at intake manifold/surge tank - ripped corner gasket discovered. Stripped bolt threads in intake manifold required helicoil repair. Solution involved replacing surge tank gasket and repairing stripped threads with properly installed helicoil using red Loctite.
key_takeaway: Idle surge issues on MK3 Supra are commonly caused by air/vacuum leaks, and a thorough inspection of intake manifold gaskets and vacuum connections should be the first diagnostic step before replacing sensors or major components.
